lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in a multi-row grid, with approximately six horizontal lines of spots visible posterior to the gill slits, decreasing in size toward the dorsal surface.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of slightly higher pixel intensity intersect with horizontal bands to form a rectilinear grid, with the high-luminance blobs serving as nodes at these intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient (top-down highlights transitioning to shadows) running parallel from the branchial region toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 5 to 7 high-luminance circular blobs are distributed within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated in the basal and medial sections.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the gill slits exhibits a high-density cluster of micro-spots that are significantly smaller than the grid-aligned blobs on the mid-lateral flank.
